steps.name: Cheerful Neighbor
steps.text: Oh, Ezell, good morning! Off to work?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Good morning. I don't... have work today. I'm taking a couple days off.

steps.name: Cheerful Neighbor
steps.text: Up so early on your day off? And look at you frowning like that. Is something bothering you? Getting bullied at the Notarial Hall?

steps.name: Cheerful Neighbor
steps.text: I told you, it may look like a decent place to work, but it's total misery over there!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Hahaha...

steps.name: Cheerful Neighbor
steps.text: Here, Ezell, I just bought some cupcakes. Take some. Let your worries go!

steps.name: Cheerful Neighbor
steps.text: It doesn't matter if work is bothering you. It's just a job. Don't think about it on your day off! Besides, aren't you still a trainee? If the ceiling caves in, it's gonna crush all your bosses up top before it ever reaches you. Don't make it so hard on yourself.

steps.name: Cheerful Neighbor
steps.text: Cheer up! It's not worth getting upset over!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Not worth it, huh?

steps.name: Cheerful Neighbor
steps.text: Still letting it bother you? Haha, anyway, I'mma get going.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Thanks for the cupcakes.
It's an early morning that couldn't be more normal. Hardly anyone on the streets yet.
But it shouldn't take much longer for the crowds to form and the usual hustle and bustle to return.
This is exactly what... Lateran life is.
How about a crepe?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: No thanks... I've got these cupcakes...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: It's you?!

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: The crepe shop on the corner there only sells two hundred of their signature crepes each day. You need to get up early to have a chance at buying one.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Thankfully, their hours haven't changed.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I'm out for a walk.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: In a city that has an arrest warrant out for you?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: What happened to the people at the Ecclesia Requietum?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: They're all in a safe place. Once everything is over, they'll leave Laterano with me.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Where to?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Who knows.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Are you going to take Cecelia with you?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: No, she left.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: H-How did you...?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: She has something she must do. It may seem trivial right now...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: But she's found her path, and she will continue down it, overcoming obstacles we could never overcome, treading into predicaments that we wouldn't dare to face, and making it to faraway places that we could never imagine.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Relax, Brother Ezell. She's far more brilliant than you and I could ever dream to be.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: But she might need you.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Why me? I'm nothing special.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: This is pretty embarrassing to say, but I was playing hero in front of her the whole time. I told her my word is my bond, and I wouldn't mind losing my job...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: But after I got home last night, I spent the whole night freaking out about everything that happened.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: A mixed-blood Sankta, a fallen angel, a Legatus, the conference at the Basilica, the Sarkaz, and a strange heretical group...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: How did I get mixed up in all this?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I thought I just wanted a decent job. A desk job would be all the better. I would go to work and leave on time, live a quiet, peaceful life... I figured that'd be pretty good for me.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Everything that happened the last couple days could be just like an interlude. I should count myself as lucky for being able to get away from it all before it's too late, and in a couple decades, I can tell stories about it to my friends...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: That'd be a pretty solid life, wouldn't it?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Maybe I shouldn't even be talking to you right now... I should just turn and run.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Aren't you going to run, then?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: There's no need to fool yourself.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: How am I supposed to know... what it is that I really want?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: You and Cecelia both asked the same question.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: She asked you that too?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Phrased a little differently.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: And how did you answer?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I told her a story.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Suddenly feeling like I shouldn't listen to you...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I just get the sense that you know how to influence people. What if you're about to sucker me into something here?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: As long as you don't want to, you won't be.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: That sounds awfully sketchy...

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: I'm here only to give you a message.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: What comes next is for you to decide.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Cecelia is going to the old bell tower.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: What is she doing there?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Saying her goodbyes.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Is something wrong?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Oh, Cecelia, aren't you scared, walking the streets all by yourself this early in the morning?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Where are those friends of yours?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Guide, it's Oren.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: No matter. We'll see what he's planning first.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: There is something I need to do here.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You're so little, but you have lots of big ideas going around in your head, huh?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I really don't get what that guy is thinking, but... sorry, little girl. I can't let you go.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Are you taking me to the Basilica?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: The Basilica? No, no, Cecelia. I can't let you go to the Basilica.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: As long as you don't go to the Basilica and the old man, you can go anywhere.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: At first, I thought it wouldn't be so bad if Andoain took you away. He's had a change of heart, but it's no biggie. I'll do it myself.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: It would be bad if I go to the Basilica?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: It's hard to say, Cecelia. Hard to say.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You're actually really important to me, you know? Feoria and I were friends... a long time ago, but still...

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Anyway, your very existence is much more useful than whatever it is you're thinking up in your little brain. If we put you to good use... you could be the greatest danger to Lateran City in a long time.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: After all, you're a Sarkaz, but you also became a Sankta.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: I don't really want to put Laterano in danger, but I need some leverage that can influence things... a bargaining chip that I can use in a deal.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: And you could be such a precious bargaining chip. I wouldn't want to see you lose your effectiveness over a tiny, little threat.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I don't understand what you're saying.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You don't need to understand, Cecelia. I'm just trying to show you I'm sincere. I won't do anything to get you hurt. I'm never one to resort to violence, if peace is an option.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: It doesn't matter what you want to do. Not now.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Could you move out of the way? I'm going to that bell tower.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Grr...
Didn't you hear? She wants you to get out of her way.

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mister Ezell! You came!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Yes, Cecelia. I promised to help you find your mama and be there when you said goodbye to her, right?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Aww. This is so touching. A mixed-blood girl between a rock and a hard place, with an executor who's true to his word... Am I watching the Lateran soap opera of the year? Makes me want to clap for you two.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: But uh, if I could, I would rather not be the villain here. This is no fun.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Ngh!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Mister Ezell!

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Sankta can't point our guns at our own kind, but violence comes in other forms. So that's no hill to die on, right?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Now! Cecelia, go! The bell tower is straight ahead!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: But...!

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I'll promise you one more thing—I'll be fine!

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Cecelia
steps.text: I'll wait for you at the top, Mister Ezell.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Very nice. You came prepared, huh? I didn't expect you to be able to hold me here.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: But still, even if I don't like screwing around with empathy, I can feel the fear in you.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Save it.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Have you ever considered that we might be walking the same road here?

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: We're definitely not right now, at least.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Show me what you've got, then.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Have you even realized the weight of the burden you're trying to shoulder?

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Can that trainee executor really hold Oren there?

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Oren's not taking this seriously, and Ezell isn't a Notarial Hall executor right now... He's not actually an obstacle to Oren.

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Actually... Guide, while I would never go against your decisions, I can't say I really agree with this...

steps.name: Patia
steps.text: Cecelia should stay with the Pathfinders. It's not only for us, but for her sake too.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: That isn't my decision. I can't decide her fate. This is a decision that only Cecelia can make for herself, Patia... Perhaps we should call it an honor to show her the choices before her.

steps.name: Andoain
steps.text: Don't worry. What I must do remains the same.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: *gasp*... *gasp*...

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Kid, for an executor in training, you aren't half bad.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I... I'm still standing...

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Looking to spend some time in the hospital, huh? I'm not out here to break bones, though.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You don't have to do this. You're just a normal guy living in Lateran City. Go home, lead a happy life. Munch on some cake or take a sip of tea, whatever.

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: I've made up my mind already.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: You folks really like talking about choices and decisions, huh? Has it ever crossed your mind that there's a price to pay when you make decisions?

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: This was only going to be an insurance policy, but well... Sorry, fellas, I need your help.

steps.name: Pathfinder Messenger
steps.text: We aren't here to help you, Oren. We're doing this because we think it's the right thing to do.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: So what do you say? 'A wise man adapts himself to circumstances.'

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Oh, that's a Yanese idiom, you see. It means...

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Too bad, Ezell...

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Ezell
steps.text: Federico!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Trainee Executor Ezell Pastore, you're being temporarily recalled. Your leave has been canceled. Please assist me with this arrest.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Oren Argiolas, your identity has been confirmed. The Seventh Tribunal has revoked your credentials as a Legatus. Please stop resisting and proceed with me to the First Tribunal.

steps.name: Oren
steps.text: Must I? I still have lots of work to take care of.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Yes, you must.
